item_name: Rothco Thin Red Line Flag Travel Mug
item_short_desc: Show your support for firefighters and fire department with Rothco's Thin Red Line Flag Travel Mug.
description: Show your support for firefighters and fire department with Rothco's Thin Red Line Flag Travel Mug. This 16oz travel cup has a double-walled, stainless steel insulation to help keep drinks hot and fresh. A US flag with a thin red line is printed on the front of the cup. The cap conveniently screws off and has a flip top for drinking. The thin red line travel mug measures 6.75" height and 3.5" diameter at widest point. Perfect for on-the-go, cars or at the office.
